description: Shell script containing functions for managing code review workflows, including setting review modes, claiming reviews, checking out main or PR branches, guarding review state, initializing review artifacts, validating artifacts, running review tests, and starting a review process.

methods.name: set_review_mode
methods.description: Sets the review mode (main or pr) and writes environment variables.

methods.name: review_claim
methods.description: Claims review responsibility for a pull request by assigning a reviewer.

methods.name: review_checkout_main
methods.description: Checks out the main branch for review.

methods.name: review_checkout_pr
methods.description: Checks out the pull request branch for review.

methods.name: review_guard
methods.description: Verifies the review environment and ensures the correct review mode and commit state.

methods.name: review_artifacts_init
methods.description: Initializes review artifacts like markdown and JSON templates.

methods.name: review_validate_artifacts
methods.description: Validates the presence and correctness of review artifacts and their contents.

methods.name: review_tests
methods.description: Runs tests related to the review process, ensuring specified test files are executed and observed.

methods.name: review_init
methods.description: Initializes a review process for a pull request, setting up environment, fetching branches, and providing guidance.
